question: 上个月一共卖了多少钱？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date)='2026-10'

question: 哪个城市卖得最好？
gold_sql: SELECT c.city, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 1

question: APP端贡献了多少订单？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') AND o.channel='APP'

question: 黑卡用户的客单价是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.amount)/COUNT(DISTINCT o.id),2) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') AND c.level='黑卡'

question: 2025年全年的销售额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date)='2025'

question: 销售额最低的3个品类是哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY gmv ASC LIMIT 3

question: 各渠道的平均订单金额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT o.channel, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount)/COUNT(DISTINCT o.id),2) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY aov DESC

question: 每天的销售额趋势是怎样的？
gold_sql: SELECT o.order_date, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') GROUP BY o.order_date ORDER BY o.order_date
